messages:
nina: Quick heads-up 1 — Asterion Therapeutics agreed to a customer profile. Interview scheduled Wed 4/7 11:00am PT. Need quote approval path, legal ok for numbers, recording owner, and inbound-lead routing for webinar follow-ups.

ben: I can own the recording + upload. Prefer Google Meet cloud recording + separate mic if the customer can. Will schedule a 10-min mic check.

derek: CS will validate the figures and provide a one-sentence product impact. I'll check with the Asterion PM today.

maria: Legal note: if we cite specific clinical throughput or cost figures we need documented approval from Asterion legal. Also flag any usage of patient examples 1 no PHI.

alex: For launch plan — we want a blog post, a short 45s social clip, and a webinar mention. Who will write the 2-line webinar teaser and demo CTA?

sophie: Design asks: please upload hi-res headshots, company logo (svg/png transparent), and any brand color guidance to /marketing/assets/asterion/. Need assets by Tue EOD to hit production.

nina: Draft quote (editable):
```
"Asterion went from prototype to production inference in under six weeks, reducing per-request cost by ~65% and improving median latency by 45% with Redwood Dedicated."
```

derek: That looks good but I'll confirm the 65% number with Ops. Might be 60% after rounding.

tanya: Demand ops question: once published, route inbound demo requests to SDR queue #east-sdr and tag campaign=asterion_q2. Can we also create a lead nurture email for webinar registrants?

alex: Yes, I7ll draft the webinar blurb + nurture cadence. Proposed blurb: "See how Asterion scaled inference to production with predictable latency and lower cost 1 join our quick demo." Thoughts?

maria: Blurb is fine. Please remove wording that implies clinical outcomes. Keep it product/ops focused. Also send final quote to legal for sign-off before publish.

ben: Recording checklist I7m using: 1) Record presenter grid + gallery if demo; 2) Local audio if possible; 3) Backup recording to GDrive; 4) Capture slides as PDF; 5) Upload raw and trimmed vids to /marketing/assets/asterion/raw/

sophie: Will prepare 3 thumbnail options and a 30s cut for paid social. Need the final quote and headshots by Tue to finalize.

derek: CS/ops confirm numbers by Tue noon. I7ll post the signed approval in this thread.

tanya: For lead routing: SDR team wants UTM parameters and a landing page slug. Can marketing ops spin up slug /demo/asterion-q2 and share the SFDC campaign id?

alex: Ops can do slug. I'll coordinate with ops and post the campaign id here once created.

nina: Timeline summary: Tue noon 1 final numbers from CS/ops; Tue EOD 1 assets in folder; Wed morning 1 rehearsal 10:40am; Wed 11:00am 1 recording; Fri 1 publish blog + social + open webinar mention.

maria: I'll review the quote and webinar copy after CS confirms numbers.

derek: Confirmed 1 I7ll drop signed numbers by Tue 11:45.

nina: Perfect 1 thanks team. I7ll create the rehearsal invite and the launch checklist in #launches. :rocket:
